scientific_question: Is a LUAD tumour-associated expression alteration present and robust to the prespecified related models?
state_resolution_rule: OBSERVED requires a traceable primary effect/significance record and its model-robustness state; material direction conflict resolves to CONFLICTING.
required_provenance: TCGA cohort|recount3/gencode_v26|final cohort|design/contrast|S0-S6 analysis versions|record IDs|artifact hashes
dependency_boundary: Effect, significance, and S1-S6 robustness share the same TCGA cohort and are one dependent evidence family.
missingness_boundary: MISSING is absence after a defined assessment; NOT_QUERIED is no assessment. Neither is negative evidence.
